facilities.name: Sjöbodviken / Lövviks gästhamn service house
facilities.description: Unstaffed service house/guest harbor serving hikers and boaters, with two three-bed rooms, shared kitchen, toilet, showers, drinking water, trash/waste handling, sauna, and wifi. Sjöbodviken site also describes camping/ställplatser, latrine disposal, service house and laundry. Important end-area service cluster, but current Naturkartan GPX endpoint stops about 0.2 km away. May need multiple normalized records: lodging, water, toilet, waste, guest harbor, sauna/service.
